objective: Take Gramma Stonefield's Note to William Pestle.

description: I bet William Pestle has a potion to unite our two young lovers!
Here, take this note to William.  He's staying at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire.
progress: You have a note from "Gramma" Stonefield, eh? I haven't seen Mildred in years! I wonder what she has to say...
completion: My heart goes out to those two poor souls, Maybell and Tommy Joe. I remember being young and in love, once.
There must be something I can do to help them! Let me think...
